learning_notes: MCP C# SDK 1.3.0 attribute-based discovery (WithResourcesFromAssembly, WithPromptsFromAssembly) is symmetric with WithToolsFromAssembly — same DI pattern, same namespace (ModelContextProtocol.Server).
TextResourceContents is the correct return type for text/JSON/markdown resources. ResourceContents is the abstract base — use TextResourceContents directly.
McpServerPromptType+McpServerPrompt with IEnumerable<ChatMessage> return is the canonical multi-turn prompt pattern per SDK docs.
ServerInfo + ServerInstructions on AddMcpServer() is the correct place to set server-level metadata — clients receive this during initialization handshake.

SlotHistory as a static ConcurrentDictionary shared between TerminalTools and TerminalResources is the correct in-process approach for session-scoped execution history — avoids IPC overhead for a single-process server.
SKILL.md deployed via terminal://skill resource implements Progressive Disclosure — skills travel with the server, not the client. This is a pattern worth formalizing in runtime-manifest.json.
